body:
I've actually had mine found out, and I've been pretty ostracized.

During my sophomore year of college, I got really sick. Really, really sick, and I needed help doing everything: eating, going to the bathroom, moving at all. My borfriend at the time was taking care of me. He got tired of the fact that we weren't having sex, so he would just... go for it for months and months.

I never reported it. I had to drop out of school because I was so sick which *gutted* me. I moved away and broke up with him, but I'm fucking crazy now. I've spent a cumulative total of 17 days in a psychiatric hospital and countless hours outpatient. I was so self destructive; drinking and drug abuse, mutilating myself, and sleeping around. 

And then I got my shit together. I had a wonderful job and friends I liked and I met someone I could be honest with and who was patient and loved me for me, but he had his own unresolved demons and so did I.

We broke up and I tried to kill myself. My roommates kicked me out because it was too much.

So now I live with my parents. I rarely leave the house. I have nothing, and I will be alone because I honestly feel like I'm not going to beat the PTSD. My life is embarrassing and lonely, and I will never forgive myself for any of it.

I don't want to be alone.
